integrated_multimodal_description: Claymation plasticine stop-motion, handcrafted modelling clay with visible fingerprints and matte finish, photographed on a miniature practical set. a small military vehicle-wash bay of riveted grey steel plates. Wet grey concrete floor, two faded yellow safety lines, one rectangular drain hole at centre with the grate lying face down beside it, red-wheel water valves and a coiled hose reel on the left wall, electric cabinets and a broom on the right wall, two stacked steel drums at rear right, a white canvas curtain on a ceiling rail at the back, a bare chain with a hook above the drain, two caged industrial lamps hanging from the riveted steel ceiling. The bay is fully ENCLOSED: the riveted steel ceiling spans the entire top of frame and solid steel walls close every side - no sky, no clouds, no windows, no daylight openings anywhere; when the camera looks up it sees only the steel ceiling, the caged lamps and the chain. Cool hard overhead light, short shadows, wet surfaces. TEO (frame left): tall thin white clay man, huge straw-blond walrus moustache, teal knitted beanie with cream stripes, red-and-black checked flannel shirt, brown suspenders, khaki trousers, dark boots. JUCA (frame right): short wide Black clay man, burnt-brown flat cap, mustard cable-knit sweater, olive-green trousers, pale wooden clogs, pencil behind the right ear. TEO and JUCA are the only two main puppets: TEO stays at frame left and JUCA stays at frame right. The military client in olive uniform appears ONLY in the shot that names him, silent, no dialogue; no other people or animals appear. The camera stays at chest height the whole time and never tilts up; the riveted steel ceiling and the caged lamps stay visible across the top of the frame in every shot - the bay is closed and has no openings. AT START: On the left, a man in overalls holds a large metal drum at center while a man on the right grips its hanging chain; two caged lamps hang overhead, a red hose reel is on the left wall, a white curtain is at the rear, a rusty drum is on the right, and the floor is cropped out with no water visible.. [Shot 1] Close insert of the steel drum still hanging on the chain, its ridged lid and brass latch filling the frame, dust flakes drifting down from the steel ceiling above it. [Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts back to the same wide shot as before, the steel drum still hanging on the chain from the ceiling hook above the drain with the riveted steel ceiling visible around it: JUCA lets the chain slip and TEO drops with it, the drum lands flat on the open drain and seals it, water swells up over both pairs of boots and the drum lid pops loose, toppling off and floating flat on the flood. [Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to a medium two-shot: TEO lands on his heels, flips the floating drum lid aside and reaches into the open drum: the green document case sits inside with a wet blank sheet on top; the military client in olive uniform leans in, pinches the sheet and lays it flat on the case like a receipt; JUCA puts both hands on his hips. They do not speak and their mouths do not move, but they breathe, swallow and react with their whole bodies. AT END: drum landed flat sealing the drain; water up over both pairs of boots; empty hook swaying on the chain draped over the sealed drum; the green document case open on the sealed drum with the blank sheet laid flat on it like a receipt.
overall_soundscape: The chain slips with a sharp clack, the drum lands flat on the drain with a deep boom, and water laps up over leather boots. A wet sheet of paper peels off the metal. TEO exhales a long sigh and JUCA clicks his tongue once.
non_diegetic_music: N/A For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.
